svg.title: M06: seven logical repositories and indexes in one shared evidence workspace
svg.desc: Five storage areas keep raw captured versions, canonical facts, evidence bindings, model proposals and assessments/cases distinct. Exact scope indexes serve all required available inputs and gap status to control tests. A separate contextual relevance index helps the Nemotron investigator find notes. External reconciliation and validation determine accepted facts; storage preserves their versions.
svg.text: M06 · Store the facts, their relationships and their history.
Proposed logical layout · seven modules, not seven services · one workspace can use several permitted physical stores

g.title: Five typed storage responsibilities; external modules own reconciliation, validation and calculation
g.text: VERSIONED RECORDS — SCOPED BY TRUSTED TEAM AND SOURCE

g.title: Captured originals establish what the source reported, not automatic factual truth
g.text: Exact source or local capture versions

g.title: Canonical facts retain authority, source lineage and unresolved states
Bindings reference specific fact and specification versions; multiple links do not create additional charges
g.text: One source can support C7 and C16

g.title: Accepted facts keep references to preserved source assertions
Bindings are relationships to existing facts rather than copied charges
Model proposals remain separate until external validation corroborates them
g.text: Keep citation, alternatives and model/extractor provenance
M12 validates; storage does not promote a guess

g.title: Assessments and cases reference both frozen source versions and accepted fact revisions
g.text: Snapshot S-01 + accepted facts F-01 + policy/evaluator
Calculations, verdicts, sufficiency and cited case CASE-01
Late corrections → linked revisions; earlier answers remain

g.title: Exact scope indexes retrieve all required available inputs plus explicit gaps, not only existing bindings
g.text: M06.6 · Exact scope index → control tests
Run/window + selected revisions + expected work + gaps
Expose pagination and index lag; source coverage is separate

g.title: Relevance indexes select contextual notes and never define the accounting population
g.text: Useful notes and attachments for cited interpretation
Top-k results cannot determine token totals or completeness

svg.text: M05 reconciles. M12 validates model proposals. Control modules calculate. M06 preserves and serves their versioned outputs.
Portable exports include the required exact inputs. A disclosed critical missing input still prevents completion of the affected claim.
